record.bible_text: Then Job<WH0347> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>,
How long will ye vex<WH03013><WTH8686> my soul<WH05315>, and break<WH01792><WTH8762> me in pieces with words<WH04405>?

Know<WH03045><WTH8798> now<WH0645> that God<WH0433> hath overthrown<WH05791><WTH8765> me, and hath compassed<WH05362><WTH8689> me with his net<WH04686>.
Behold, I cry out<WH06817><WTH8799> of wrong<WH02555>, but I am not heard<WH06030><WTH8735>: I cry aloud<WH07768><WTH8762>, but <FI>there is<Fi> no judgment<WH04941>. <RF>wrong: or, violence<Rf><CM>
He hath fenced up<WH01443><WTH8804> my way<WH0734> that I cannot pass<WH05674><WTH8799>, and he hath set<WH07760><WTH8799> darkness<WH02822> in my paths<WH05410>.
He hath stripped<WH06584><WTH8689> me of my glory<WH03519>, and taken<WH05493><WTH8686> the crown<WH05850> <FI>from<Fi> my head<WH07218>.
He hath destroyed<WH05422><WTH8799> me on every side<WH05439>, and I am gone<WH03212><WTH8799>: and mine hope<WH08615> hath he removed<WH05265><WTH8686> like a tree<WH06086>.
He hath also kindled<WH02734><WTH8686> his wrath<WH0639> against me, and he counteth<WH02803><WTH8799> me unto him as <FI>one of<Fi> his enemies<WH06862>.
His troops<WH01416> come<WH0935><WTH8799> together<WH03162>, and raise up<WH05549><WTH8799> their way<WH01870> against me, and encamp<WH02583><WTH8799> round about<WH05439> my tabernacle<WH0168>.
He hath put<WH07368><WH00> my brethren<WH0251> far<WH07368><WTH8689> from me, and mine acquaintance<WH03045><WTH8802> are verily estranged<WH02114><WTH8804> from me.
My kinsfolk<WH07138> have failed<WH02308><WTH8804>, and my familiar friends<WH03045><WTH8794> have forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> me.
They that dwell<WH01481><WTH8802> in mine house<WH01004>, and my maids<WH0519>, count<WH02803><WTH8799> me for a stranger<WH02114><WTH8801>: I am an alien<WH05237> in their sight<WH05869>.
I called<WH07121><WTH8804> my servant<WH05650>, and he gave <FI>me<Fi> no answer<WH06030><WTH8799>; I intreated<WH02603><WTH8691> him with<WH01119> my mouth<WH06310>.

My breath<WH07307> is strange<WH02114><WTH8804> to my wife<WH0802>, though I intreated<WH02589><WTH8800> for the children's<WH01121> <FI>sake<Fi> of mine own body<WH0990>. <RF>mine...: Heb. my belly<Rf>
Yea, young children<WH05759> despised<WH03988><WTH8804> me; I arose<WH06965><WTH8799>, and they spake<WH01696><WTH8762> against me. <RF>young...: or, the wicked<Rf>

My bone<WH06106> cleaveth<WH01692><WTH8804> to my skin<WH05785> and to my flesh<WH01320>, and I am escaped<WH04422><WTH8691> with the skin<WH05785> of my teeth<WH08127>. <RF>and to: or, as to<Rf>
Have pity<WH02603><WTH8798> upon me, have pity<WH02603><WTH8798> upon me, O ye my friends<WH07453>; for the hand<WH03027> of God<WH0433> hath touched<WH05060><WTH8804> me.
Why do ye persecute<WH07291><WTH8799> me as God<WH0410>, and are not satisfied<WH07646><WTH8799> with my flesh<WH01320>?<CM>

Oh that<WH05414><WTH8799> my words<WH04405> were now<WH0645> written<WH03789><WTH8735>! oh that<WH05414><WTH8799> they were printed<WH02710><WTH8714> in a book<WH05612>! <RF>Oh...: Heb. Who will give, etc<Rf>
That they were graven<WH02672><WTH8735> with an iron<WH01270> pen<WH05842> and lead<WH05777> in the rock<WH06697> for ever<WH05703>!
For I know<WH03045><WTH8804> <FI>that<Fi> my redeemer<WH01350><WTH8802> liveth<WH02416>, and <FI>that<Fi> he shall stand<WH06965><WTH8799> at the latter<WH0314> <FI>day<Fi> upon the earth<WH06083>:

And <FI>though<Fi> after<WH0310> my skin<WH05785> <FI>worms<Fi> destroy<WH05362><WTH8765> this <FI>body<Fi> , yet in my flesh<WH01320> shall I see<WH02372><WTH8799> God<WH0433>: <RF>And...: or, After I shall awake, though this body be destroyed, yet out of my flesh<Rf>

Whom I shall see<WH02372><WTH8799> for myself, and mine eyes<WH05869> shall behold<WH07200><WTH8804>, and not another<WH02114><WTH8801>; <FI>though<Fi> my reins<WH03629> be consumed<WH03615><WTH8804> within<WH02436> me. <RF>another: Heb. a stranger<Rf> <RF>though...: or, my reins within me are consumed with earnest desire (for that day)<Rf> <RF>within...: Heb. in my bosom<Rf>

But ye should say<WH0559><WTH8799>, Why persecute<WH07291><WTH8799> we him, seeing the root<WH08328> of the matter<WH01697> is found<WH04672><WTH8738> in me? <RF>seeing...: or, and what root of matter is found in me?<Rf>

Be ye afraid<WH01481><WTH8798> of the sword<WH02719>: for wrath<WH02534> <FI>bringeth<Fi> the punishments<WH05771> of<WH06440> the sword<WH02719>, that ye may know<WH03045><WTH8799> <FI>there is<Fi> a judgment<WH01779><WTH8675><WH01779>.<CM>
